name: recoil_state_credits_static_init_and_register_at_exit
description: RecoilStateCredits::StaticInitAndRegisterAtExit constructs the global credits state and registers its at-exit destructor.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent RecoilStateCredits static-lifetime pass.
